rootCause: Previous review package was derived from data/review/media-rights-registry.json, which was derived from src/content/robots.generated.json. That generated file only exposes the optimized square /images/kiber-45/*.webp hero plus gallery array, so the original horizontal live-site/Tilda robot-page hero background images from site-export HTML were not included in the human media-rights documents.
